prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” AI video ad maker — the right choice depends on your goals (platform, creative style, budget, need for avatars or localization, scale). Below are the best-in-class options by use case plus quick guidance to pick one.

Top picks (by use case)
- Synthesia
  - Best for: realistic AI presenters / multi-language voiceovers and fast, brand-safe corporate or explainers.
  - Pros: high-quality avatars, many languages, simple script -> video flow.
  - Cons: less flexible for free-form footage or heavy custom visuals; cost rises for scale.

- HeyGen / Movio (similar category)
  - Best for: quick presenter-based ads with different avatars and fast localization.
  - Pros: easy to use, cheaper alternatives to Synthesia for some workflows.
  - Cons: avatar realism varies; licensing terms differ — check commercial use.

- Runway
  - Best for: creative, generative, and advanced edits (text-to-video, background/scene generation).
  - Pros: cutting-edge generative tools and frame-level control for standout visuals.
  - Cons: steeper learning curve; can be compute/intensive.

- Pictory
  - Best for: turning long-form content (webinars, blogs) into short social ads.
  - Pros: automated summarization, captions, template-based outputs.
  - Cons: less control over bespoke motion graphics.

- InVideo
  - Best for: fast template-driven social/video ads on a budget.
  - Pros: lots of templates, drag-and-drop, affordable plans.
  - Cons: output can look templated if you don’t customize.

- VEED.IO
  - Best for: quick edits, subtitles, simple AI enhancements for social ads.
  - Pros: simple UI, auto-subtitles, basic AI tools, collaborative.
  - Cons: not focused on deep generative creation.

- Lumen5
  - Best for: turning articles/posts into short ads or social clips.
  - Pros: automated text-to-video with templates.
  - Cons: limited creative control compared with manual editors.

How to pick the “best” for you
1. Define platform & format (15s vertical for Reels/TikTok, 6s bumper, 16:9 YouTube).  
2. Prioritize features: AI avatars? Voice localization? Template speed? Deep generative visuals?  
3. Budget & scale: free trials exist — compare per-video cost and seat/licensing for commercial ads.  
4. Try 2–3 tools with the same script/creative and A/B test on your ad platform.  
5. Check rights and voice licensing for commercial use and personalization options for dynamic creative.

If you want a short recommendation:
- For most marketers who want professional, localized presenter ads: try Synthesia first.  
- For creative, standout visuals: try Runway.  
- For low-cost, fast social ads: try InVideo or Pictory.

If you tell me: platform (TikTok, Meta, YouTube), budget per month, whether you need avatars or existing footage, and how many ads you need per month, I’ll recommend 2 specific tools and a quick test plan.
